trial_title: Doripenem in the Treatment of Complicated Lower Urinary Tract Infection or Pyelonephritis
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to assess the microbiological cure rate of doripenem in the treatment of patients with complicated urinary tract infection or pyelonephritis. The study will also characterize the safety and tolerability of treatment with doripenem in patients with complicated urinary tract infection or pyelonephritis.

eligibility_table.criterion: Diagnosis of complicated lower urinary tract infection or pyelonephritis
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has a history of complicated UTIs, which meets the inclusion criterion.

eligibility_table.criterion: Women who are pregnant, nursing or of child-bearing potential and not using a medically accepted, effective method of birth control
eligibility_table.justification: The patient is of child-bearing potential, has a serum β-hCG level indicating possible pregnancy, and is not using effective birth control.

eligibility_table.criterion: History of moderate or severe hypersensitivity reactions to antibiotic medications
eligibility_table.justification: There is no information provided regarding any history of hypersensitivity reactions to antibiotics, making it indeterminate.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient experienced any moderate or severe hypersensitivity reactions to antibiotic medications in the past?
